But B's stronger history-adaptive ordinary streaming policy matches or improves both selected full histories, and C's pretranslation/coupler/primer ordinary control is event-equivalent. accepted_positive_design.rule: Freeze L<=r+Q before first AWVALID; initial Q3. True resident r belongs exclusively to the new physical child. At starvation its current true debt is <=Q. Every resumed patch must make true progress before reconversion; per child <=Q conversions, <=Q(Q+1)/2 null W and <=1+Q AW.
accepted_positive_design.necessary_mapping_scope: Retaining only the current child translation is insufficient. Future R of an already accepted long source AR can fill the FIFO while the next child requests a fresh PTE. Prepare and retain WRITE coverage for the entire accepted return envelope, or split source AR before commitment at a verified boundary.
accepted_positive_design.necessary_owner_boundary: The logical parent must not claim an N-length W owner upstream. Actual child/repair descriptors and their true physical LAST must be arranged before every W-owner mux.
accepted_positive_design.necessary_admission: One nonfullbuffer priming source; other accepted source returns have full reservation. Null physical LAST releases only physical ownership, not the priming envelope's logical true-byte debt or successful completion.
accepted_positive_design.new_direct_source_result: Native TL has normal/debug/ATS response routing and no prepared-parent origin. Add an explicit origin and response handshake rather than misuse ATS/debug or assume the current virtual-AW path reuses a parent PA without a walk. A trusted range-checked physical path and ID/response routing must be costed.
